hey folks,

i’m excited to share that i’ve joined Microsoft as a software engineer!

stepping into a new role with exciting challenges, new opportunities, and plenty of room to learn, grow, and contribute towards impact.

looking forward to the journey ahead!
comment: A new role is also a chance to learn the unwritten systems behind great engineering teams—how decisions are made, tradeoffs handled, and ideas move from prototypes to products at scale.
